name: @pacsarcade/page-store
description: The puck-studio document store — KV draft/live staging, publish, page management and the popup registry behind sovereign storage drivers: Upstash-REST KV (the shipping default, byte-identical to the host file it was extracted from), JSON files for zero-infrastructure local dev, and a scoped (deliberately unimplemented) git driver. Optional site-namespaced keys with a legacy compat read, so two sites can share one KV without colliding.
